articles.headline: NBA championship and Finals MVP odds: Thunder remain title favorites heading into Game 7 vs. Spurs
articles.description: Game 7 is set for Saturday in Oklahoma City, with the Thunder-Spurs winner playing the Eastern Conference champion Knicks in the NBA Finals.

images.name: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander [1296x729]
images.caption: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Victor Wembanyama are Nos. 1 and 2 in the Finals MVP odds, respectively.

images.name: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander [608x342]
images.caption: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the Thunder are back to being odds-on title favorites after taking a 3-2 series lead over the Spurs.
images.alt: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander

images.name: Jalen Brunson [608x342]
images.caption: Jalen Brunson has the New York Knicks in the NBA Finals for the first time since 1999.
images.alt: Jalen Brunson

images.name: Knicks/Cavs [1296x729]
images.caption: The Knicks are looking to end the series against the Cavaliers tonight, as they have the second-shortest title odds and are an overwhelming favorite to win the East.
images.alt: New York Knicks guard Landry Shamet (L) defends Cleveland Cavaliers guard Donovan Mitchell (R) during game 3 of the NBA East Conference Finals between the Cleveland Cavaliers and the New York Knicks in Cleveland, Ohio, USA, 23 May 2026.

images.name: Jalen Brunson [608x342]
images.caption: The Knicks are now heavy favorites to win the Eastern Conference after taking a 3-0 series lead over the Cavs.
images.alt: Jalen Brunson
images.credit: Nathaniel S. Butler/NBAE via Getty Images

images.name: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander  [1296x729]
images.caption: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander how has even odds to win the Finals MVP.

images.name: Cade Cunningham [1296x729]
images.caption: Cade Cunningham and the Pistons are favored heading into Game 7.
images.alt: Detroit Pistons guard Cade Cunningham (2) shoots over Cleveland Cavaliers guard Sam Merrill (5) in the second half during game five of the second round of the 2026 NBA Playoffs at Little Caesars Arena.

images.caption: The loss of Anthony Edwards put a damper on the Timberwolves' championship odds.

article.headline: Sabonis stars as DeRozan and the streaking Kings beat the Bulls 124-119
article.description: — Domantas Sabonis had 22 points, 15 rebounds and eight assists, and the Sacramento Kings beat the Chicago Bulls 124-119 on Sunday to extend their season-high win streak to seven games.
article.linkText: Sabonis stars as DeRozan and the streaking Kings beat the Bulls 124-119

images.name: Josh Giddey nears triple-double in Bulls' loss to Kings
images.caption: Josh Giddey posts 12 points, 11 rebounds and seven assists as the Chicago Bulls go down to the Sacramento Kings.

article.story: CHICAGO -- — Domantas Sabonis had 22 points, 15 rebounds and eight assists, and the Sacramento Kings beat the Chicago Bulls 124-119 on Sunday to extend their season-high win streak to seven games. De’Aaron Fox scored 26 points and grabbed nine rebounds for Sacramento after missing three games because of a bruised right glute. Malik Monk had 18 points, nine assists and eight rebounds. DeMar DeRozan got a warm reception in his return to Chicago and finished with 21 points. The six-time All-Star spent three seasons with the Bulls before leaving for Sacramento in a three-team trade in July. Sabonis had another big outing after he had 23 points and a season-high 28 rebounds against Boston on Friday. He helped the Kings improved to 7-1 under interim coach Doug Christie, who took over when Mike Brown was fired on Dec. 27. Zach LaVine led Chicago with 36 points. Making his first start since Jan. 14, 2022, Lonzo Ball set season highs with 15 points and five 3s. Takeaways Kings: The Kings made enough plays down the stretch to come away with another win. Bulls: LaVine continues to roll along with six straight 30-point games. Key moment LaVine made two free throws and a turnaround jumper to cut Sacramento's lead to one with 2:28 remaining. Fox bumped the lead back to three when he made two foul shots with 1:29 left. Vucevic blocked a drive by Monk with 22 seconds remaining. The Bulls then got called for a five-second violation following a timeout, and Sabonis hit two free throws to make it 124-119 with 14 seconds left. Key stat Fox went 4 for 8 from long range. Up next Both teams are back at it on Tuesday, with the Kings visiting Giannis Antetokounmpo and the Milwaukee Bucks and the Bulls hosting New Orleans. ------ AP NBA: https://www.apnews.com/hub/NBA
